Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

Case No.: DR-2020-05, MUP-2020-06, LM-2020-01 Location: 1041-1043 W. Arrow Hwy., Azusa, California
APN: 8619-016-044, 8619-016-045
Applicant: GroupArch Development, Inc.
The City of Azusa received a request for Design Review to construct a single-story, 3,008 s.f. commercial building (car wash), a Minor Use Permit request for a minor vehicle services (car wash) use, and a Lot Merger request to merge two parcels into one.
This project is categorically exempt from environmental review per Class 32 Categorical Exemption (State CEQA Guidelines, § 15332), (California Environmental Quality Act).
